profile.headline: Software Developer creating tailored solutions and streamlining operations.
profile.summary: Software Engineer and Data manager with 5-year background in the product research industry. Broad knowledge of survey software and data editors. Interested in finding a direct to hire job to develop more programming skills, pursuing a database position, or any other job to expand my knowledge.

positions.title: Lead Software Developer / Owner
positions.description:
• Spearheaded the development of custom web applications and automation tools for local organizations and small businesses.  
• Provided expert consulting services to enhance clients' software capabilities and operational efficiency.  
• Managed all aspects of the business, ensuring high-quality service delivery and client satisfaction.
positions.insights: Skills: GitHub · ASP.NET MVC · Visual Studio · C# · Application Programming Interfaces (API) · .NET Core · HTML · ASP.NET

positions.title: Founder
positions.description: Founded and operate a software development and consulting business providing custom web applications, automation tools, and hosted solutions for local organizations and small businesses. Design and develop ASP.NET Core applications with SQL Server backends, integrating third-party services and building scalable architectures that support future development.

positions.title: Senior Sql Developer
positions.description: Skills: Streamlining Operations · .NET Framework · C# · Application Programming Interfaces (API) · Teamwork · SQL

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Developed and maintained internal web and console applications using C# and SQL to automate and streamline company processes. Built a web application that replaced manual workflows for contractor and employee account creation with a third-party system, integrating APIs to synchronize data between systems and databases. Reduced account creation time from up to five business days to just five minutes. Designed scalable database structures and stored procedures, managed source control with TFS, and implemented Active Directory group-based access to manage user permissions and facility relationships. Partnered with IT and leadership to improve existing systems and identify new opportunities for efficiency.

positions.title: .NET Developer
positions.description: Back end and application support. Store and warehouse application support, using SSMS to fix issues and the data. Documentation of all processes done with support and of database prep for new store locations opening. Development of an internal .net application for new store processes and support.

positions.title: Dotnet Developer
positions.description: Back end and application support. Store and warehouse application support, using SSMS to fix issues and the data. Documentation of all processes done with support and of database prep for new store locations opening. Development of an internal .net application for new store processes and support.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: Front end and back end development. Server and web admin management. Hardware and software IT work. Create websites for multiple clients and manage posting databases and front end maintenance. With some server hosting management and occasional IT work at client locations.

positions.title: Full Stack Engineer
positions.description: Company site lead developer. Develop and manage a business website, viewed and used by employees and clients. Manage the data, site, and reports to help and increase their capability. Constantly developing enhancements and correcting issues with the site. Managing my team of developers and their development for the website.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Preparing product research data for client statisticians. Diverse role of web-programming utilizing custom coding to provide innovative survey development. Collection and preparation of data to generate for a ready to analyze file.

positions.title: Java Programmer
positions.description: Diverse role of web-programming utilizing custom coding to provide innovative survey development. Collection and preparation of data to generate for a ready to analyze file for Procter and Gamble.

positions.title: Data Analyst
positions.description:
Preparing product research data for client statisticians

Worked with the programmers of the questionnaires to limit any rework done. Clean the data, formatting it as requested, and providing the easiest method for the statisticians to review their data. Involving multiple data merges and formatting.

positions.title: Data Management Specialist
positions.description: Onsite supervisor for preparing product research data for client statisticians. Worked with the programmers of the questionnaires to limit any rework done. Clean the data, formatting it as requested, and providing the easiest method for the statisticians to review their data. Involving multiple data merges and formatting.

positions.title: Production Technician
positions.description:
Managed and created accounts for clients. Ran and sent production files to carriers. Kept coworkers’ workstation at working capacity.

Team member of the IT department, executing finished projects to create files to send to clients, managed and created accounts for clients in BenXCel. Kept coworkers’ capable of working, giving them the access and programs needed to do their work. Also, helped if their station wasn’t working up to par
